verdict.rationale: Modal's marketing explicitly ties per-second billing to sandboxes: GPUs "attach to any sandbox… pay by the second with no reserved capacity" (modal-docs-5, modal-docs-16). The pricing page adds "only pay for what you use" and says you can burst without over-allocating CPU or memory in advance (modal-docs-7, modal-docs-17). A community builder corroborates paying only for needed resources on Modal Sandboxes (modal-comm-1). Missing for 10: detailed first-party pricing docs giving per-second CPU/memory rates for sandboxes, clarity on whether idle or allocated-but-unused resources are billed, and stronger independent hands-on billing corroboration.
